beers.deleteWithCaps_one: Its cap and the cap's photo are deleted too. This can't be undone.
beers.deleteWithCaps_other: Its {{count}} caps and their photos are deleted too. This can't be undone.
beers.mergeExplanation_one: Use this for a duplicate. Its cap moves to the beer you pick, then {{name}} is deleted. A country or rating the other beer lacks is taken over.
beers.mergeExplanation_other: Use this for a duplicate. Its {{count}} caps move to the beer you pick, then {{name}} is deleted. A country or rating the other beer lacks is taken over.

brand.usedBy_one: Used by {{count}} beer. Merge it into another brand instead.
brand.usedBy_other: Used by {{count}} beers. Merge it into another brand instead.
brand.mergeExplanation_one: Use this for a duplicate. Its beer moves to the brand you pick, then {{name}} is deleted. A beer the other brand already has is joined with it, so their caps end up together.
brand.mergeExplanation_other: Use this for a duplicate. Its {{count}} beers move to the brand you pick, then {{name}} is deleted. A beer the other brand already has is joined with it, so their caps end up together.

country.usedBy_one: Used by {{count}} beer. Merge it into another country instead.
country.usedBy_other: Used by {{count}} beers. Merge it into another country instead.
country.mergeExplanation_one: Use this for a duplicate. Its beer moves to the country you pick, then {{name}} is deleted.
country.mergeExplanation_other: Use this for a duplicate. Its {{count}} beers move to the country you pick, then {{name}} is deleted.

backups.intro: A backup copies the database and every cap photo to the server's disk: photos as a folder, the database as an SQL file.
backups.deleteMessage: Its files are removed from the server. This can't be undone.

pipeline.intro: Run these after adding caps, in order. Each step works on the whole collection and can take several minutes on the server.
pipeline.variationsText: Creates rotated and re-lit copies of every cap photo.
pipeline.describeText: Turns every variation into numbers the search can compare.
pipeline.indexText: Makes the Matcher use the new descriptions.
